OpenLF1

An open-source reimplementation of Little Fighter (1995) — the original's introduction, menus, character selection, and side-view battles.

Play in your browser View source on GitHub Download Visit OpenLF2

What you can play

OpenLF1 recreates the original game's presentation and early gameplay while the remaining features are filled in.

Introduction & menus

The original introduction, menu flow, and character selection screens.

Side-view battles

Local battles with the original fighters, stages, and items.

Keyboard & gamepad

Keyboard controls or up to three controllers, with a fullscreen toggle.

Original game data

Reads the Little Fighter ZIP archive directly. Nothing is extracted or modified.

Runs locally

The browser build downloads the game once and then runs entirely on your device.

MIT-licensed

OpenLF1's code, scripts, and documentation are MIT-licensed. The original game is not included.

Play in your browser

This build runs entirely on your device. Press Start game to download the original Little Fighter (1995) game data from archive.org (about 455 KB, checked by SHA-256), or select your own game ZIP manually. Your browser saves the ZIP for future visits; a selected file is never uploaded anywhere.
